mapper.sql: MENU_NUMB , SUBX_NUMB , MENU_NAME , MENU_URLX , SORT_ORDR , USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , UPDT_DATE
P.MENU_NUMB , P.SUBX_NUMB , P.MENU_NAME , P.MENU_URLX , P.SORT_ORDR , P.USEE_YSNO , P.USEE_YSNO_NAME , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_ADMN , P.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , P.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT /* getMenuList */ M.MENU_NUMB , M.SUBX_NUMB , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_URLX , M.SORT_ORDR , M.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, M.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , M.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , M.REGI_DATE , M.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , M.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_ADMENU M JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB AND A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} AND A.READ_YSNO = #{yes} JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE AND NVL(G.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} LEFT JOIN TM_ADMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND P.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} WHERE NVL(M.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} ORDER BY NVL(P.SORT_ORDR, M.SORT_ORDR) , TO_NUMBER(M.MENU_NUMB) , CASE WHEN M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , NVL(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , TO_NUMBER(M.SUBX_NUMB)

SELECT /* getMenuPermission */ NVL(MAX(A.READ_YSNO), #{no}) AS READ_YSNO , NVL(MAX(A.WRIT_YSNO), #{no}) AS WRIT_YSNO , NVL(MAX(A.DELT_YSNO), #{no}) AS DELT_YSNO FROM TM_ADMENU M JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB AND A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE AND NVL(G.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} WHERE TRIM(M.MENU_URLX) = #{menuUrlx}

SELECT /* getMenuMngList */
FROM ( SELECT R.MENU_NUMB , R.SUBX_NUMB , R.MENU_NAME , R.MENU_URLX , R.SORT_ORDR , R.USEE_YSNO , R.USEE_YSNO_NAME , R.REGI_ADMN , R.REGI_ADMN_NAME , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_ADMN , R.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , R.UPDT_DATE , ROWNUM AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT FROM TM_ADMENU M WHERE M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} ORDER BY NVL(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , TO_NUMBER(M.MENU_NUMB) ) R WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB >= #{startRow}
SELECT /* getMenuMngCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_ADMENU WHERE SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb}
SELECT /* getMenuNumb */ TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(MENU_NUMB)), 0) + 1) FROM TM_ADMENU WHERE SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb}
SELECT /* getSubxNumb */ TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBX_NUMB)), -1) + 1) FROM TM_ADMENU WHERE MENU_NUMB = #{menuNumb}
